messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sweeps window and ACH token refresh

Hi Laura / AP team,

Quick follow on invoice INV-2027-331 (due 2027-03-31). We need to confirm two things so the sweep goes through cleanly:
1) Earliest sweep cut (your timezone) you can do on 2027-03-31 — our accounting cut is 6:00 PM PST, so if you can target that window that helps our reconciliation.
2) ACH token refresh — our bank requires a refreshed token or signed authorization on file before we can accept an automated sweep from a new payor profile. I attached a bank-authorization-template.pdf for your finance team to sign, or feel free to use your portal.

Please confirm: sweep time, whether you'll use the secure portal link or if you want us to return a signed PDF, and the remittance reference you will post (please include RDW-8891). If anything blocks you, loop in finance@starlite.io and cc me.

Thanks —
David Kim
Senior Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: invoice-2027-331.pdf, bank-authorization-template.pdf

From: Laura Emerson <laura.emerson@starlite.io>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: payments@starlite.io, finance@starlite.io
Date: Sat, 27 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sweeps window and ACH token refresh

David — thanks for the heads up. A couple quick notes: 
- We can schedule the sweep for 6:00 PM PST on 2027-03-31; our bank processes nightly batches and that time cleanly aligns with our posting cycle.
- For the ACH token: our standard process is to accept a signed authorization OR a portal authorization (preferred for security). If you can confirm the portal route, finance will accept the token refresh there.

Action items for Redwood: please either upload the signed authorization to the portal link or confirm we should expect the signed pdf. If you send the PDF, please include a contact name/phone for the bank to reach out to for validation.

One additional ask: please provide the last four digits of the remit account you expect to see (we will mask on our side in the posting).

Best,
Laura Emerson
AP Manager, Starlite Health
